title: The kingdom of the Fates
summary: A hidden realm in the Silver Sea.

claims.text: On a great island in the Silver Sea lies a kingdom ringed by trackless desert, impassable mountains and a river of inky dark; it is said to blend the best of both Courts, home to heroes, sages and poets whose work in the world is done.
Its ruler, King Thelat, consults the Fates often, an honor few moirae can claim; most think Thelat an ancient sidhe lord, some think Thelat older still.

Each fir-bholg must eat one particular raw food every week, such as fresh fish, carrion, oak roots or rainwater, a craving tied to Fomorian blood; deprived of it, a fir-bholg weakens and will do almost anything to get it.

title: The naraka
summary: Changelings born of a Dreaming destroyed in 1999.

claims.text: In the summer of 1999 the Dreaming around Bangladesh was almost wiped out by fire; the naraka emerged into the Autumn World from that wasteland, the first thing they saw being Kali the destroyer, whom they took as mother.
They wandered at first under Samvarta, the Doomsday Cloud, among corpses and ruins that held no disbelief, unaware of Banality's chill.
